# Prillie Rogerson

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Prillie Rogerson is described as a small beauty. She has long brown curls and hazel eyes.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Despite her attractive appearance, Prillie Rogerson is known for being awful, mean, and horrid.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)_

## Traits

- mean and horrid  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>

## History

Prillie Rogerson lived with her grandmother in Grafton before her father remarried and brought her home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She became one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's pupils when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023)_
